summary: Seabridge Gold filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of a plan of arrangement to spin off its Courageous Lake gold project into a new entity, Valor Gold Corp. The spin-out was approved by over 99% of votes cast. Under the terms, Seabridge will transfer 100% of the project to Valor and distribute 55 million Valor shares to Seabridge shareholders on a basis of approximately one Valor share per 1.957 Seabridge shares held. The arrangement remains subject to a British Columbia Supreme Court final order hearing on May 27, 2026, with an anticipated closing on or about June 3, 2026. Post-closing, Valor expects to list on the TSX and OTCQB, while old Seabridge shares will be suspended and new Seabridge shares will trade under a new CUSIP/ISIN. Watch for court approval and listing completion as catalysts.
